english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not firmly fixed, not tight-fitting, or loose in texture.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something physical is loose, lax, or not pulled tight.

examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 sung1 laa3

examples.english: This rope is not pulled tight; it is still slack.
examples.traditional: 呢條繩未拉實，仲有啲鬆。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 mei6 laai1 sat6 zung6 jau5 di1 sung1
